verdict.rationale: Event-triggered automation is a fair question for a cloud agent product like Perplexity Computer, so the axis applies. The evidence only covers on-demand task delegation via MCP, connectors, approvals and progress notifications. Nothing documents user-defined rules or triggers that fire actions automatically on events; scheduling calendar events is a one-off action, not an event-driven rule.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
